notes.title: More level variations
notes.content:
- Add more level variations
- Remove experimental local co-op

notes.title: Local Coop & More level variations
notes.content:
- Having 2 controllers connected at welcome screen will spawn an additional player in game scene
- Added more variations of levels

notes.title: Destructibles
notes.content:
- Add destructible environment blocks that may have explosive or souls
- Added temp background art
- Added shooting VFX
- Added visual details in the shop

notes.title: Killing Spree
notes.content:
- Added killing spree award for killing 10 enemies in short window
- Reverted 360 movement

notes.title: New movement testing
notes.content:
- Testing continuous movement direction (compared to cardinal)
- Abilities use change (again): Use L1 or R1 to use upgrades
- Added support for D-pad
- Can use L2 to dodge too

notes.title: Abilities Use Change
notes.content:
- Unlocking abilities unlocks a chance for enemy to drop a power loot on death
- 20% chance of dropping loot on death
- Added demon fish and bomb SFX
- Added level variations
- Improved bomb and hammer abilities visuals

notes.title: Abilities Use Change
notes.content:
- Abilities now use a charge
- Charge is gained by dodging through enemies
- New upgrade - angry fish

notes.title: New Upgrade
notes.content:
- Add new upgrade - Katana
- Improve transition to game
- Scale shops items costs with level progression
- Press M to toggle mouse input
